handoff_instructions: M2-T26 complete. Re-applied workflow/wip/M2-T26.patch (helpers.ts deliverVoiceEvent + packages/workflows/test/acceptance/call-lifecycle.test.ts), fixing a missing `vapiRequest` import in helpers.ts and trimming call-lifecycle.test.ts to 192 lines (removed now-unused randomUUID import, shortened two tool-call literals to fit Prettier's line width) so the file stays within the 200-line hard limit. While wiring it up, found and fixed a real bug blocking 'warm transfer works': packages/core/src/services/receptionist.ts (resolveTransferDestination) and packages/workflows/src/receptionist-runtime.ts (executeReceptionistToolCalls) called recordCall without providerCallId, so an in-progress call's calls.provider_call_id stayed null and packages/core/src/services/transfer.ts transferCall could never find it (NotFoundError) until the call ended -- added `providerCallId: params.callId` (Vapi's call id) to both recordCall calls, 1 line each. Added packages/workflows/test/acceptance/duplicate-and-audit.test.ts (116 lines) covering the remaining M2-T26 acceptance items through the real receptionist tool-calls path: duplicate webhook redelivery does not duplicate the lead, concurrent identical deliveries do not duplicate the lead, and a late/out-of-order tool-calls redelivery after the end-of-call report never resurrects a completed call. All 8 M2 acceptance criteria (call business number, identifies company, qualifies fake lead, safely looks up permitted business info, creates lead + call summary, warm transfer works incl. Vapi's native transfer-destination-request, duplicate webhook does not duplicate lead, all calls/actions auditable) are now asserted under packages/workflows/test/acceptance. Verified: `pnpm --filter @backoffice/workflows exec vitest run test/acceptance` (2 files, 8 tests, all pass), `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm -r test` (all packages, all green), and `pnpm test:workflow`. No files under workflow/ (other than this state.json), .github/, or check-config files were touched. Next: reviewer should check the acceptance suite's diff plus the two 1-line providerCallId fixes.
